Name: Smelly Vase Bong Shop Mod
Author: joythebardlock
Description:
[b][size=5]"Smelly Vase" Bong Shop Mod[/size][/b]
Tired of searching high and low for the mysterious Smelly Vase? This mod makes the Smelly Vase available for purchase at Robin's shop for 420g—no crafting required!

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Adds the Smelly Vase to Robin's shop inventory
[*]Price set at 420g
[*]Fully ingegrated with Stardew Valley Expanded content
[/list]
[b][size=5]NEW UPDATES
[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=4]Always for sale in Robin's store.[/size]
[*][size=4]Only sold if seen Sebastian's 2 heart event.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Requirements UPDATED
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url]
[*]Bong Furniture SVE Asset | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/257658097]joythebardlock[/url] (me)
[*]SMAPI | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]
[*]Content Patcher | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]
[*]Farm Type Manager (FTM) | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/56561342]EscaMMC[/url]
[*]ShopTileFramework | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3590100]CherryChain[/url]
[*]Expanded Preconditions Utility | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3590100]CherryChain[/url]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.
[*]Install Content Patcher.
[*]Install Stardew Valley Expanded, Bong Furniture SVE Asset, and other required mods listed above.
[*]Download and unzip SmellyVaseShopMod.rar.
[*]Place the folder into your Mods directory.
[*]Launch the game with SMAPi.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Built for Stardew Valley Expanded
[*]Works with all colors of the Bong Furniture SVE Asset, but only one color at a time.
[*]Should not conflict with most other shop mods.
[*]Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer.
[/list][size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size][list]
[*]The vase is purely decorative (but has the best dankness smell).
[*]If you're not seeing it, make sure all of your mods are up to date and that the files are renamed correctly if instructed to do so.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: This is a more thoroughly tested version of the mod that has the smelly vase in stock at Robin's shop everyday she is open, but only if you have seen Sebastian's 2 heart event. The icon is small, for now, because I don't know how to fix it.

Manifest.Name: Smelly Vase Shop Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds the Smelly Vase and its crafting recipe to Robin's shop after the special event.
Manifest.Author: JoyTheBardlock
